title: Experiment milestone rubric and traffic safeguards for staged rollouts
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Create a prescriptive milestone rubric and automated traffic-safeguard configuration for staged model experiments (A/B tests, canaries, progressive rollouts). Purpose: give PM/Eng/Design a single, actionable checklist that maps data, telemetry, and decision thresholds to traffic phases so rollouts are repeatable, measurable, and safe for customer traffic.
milestones: Phase 0 - Lab validation (internal): unit tests, eval harness on seed prompts, performance baseline vs control. Goal: pass offline quality checks and perf regression thresholds.
Phase 1 - Canary (1% global, 24h): automated health checks, telemetry collection (latency, error, quality eval), human review trigger if unexpected signals appear.
Phase 2 - Ramp (5% -> 20% over 72h): monitor regional splits, cost delta, token-level caching effectiveness; stop if any gate trips.
Phase 3 - Broad (50%+ or 100%): post-deployment quality sweep, roll forward if stable, otherwise stagger rollback plan per region.
Post-release - Continuous evaluation (30d): maintain evaluation set monitoring, alert on quality drift or cost anomalies and schedule follow-up experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Offline eval: model passes baseline eval set with quality delta <= 0.5 percentage points against control on key metrics (accuracy/ROUGE/F1 as appropriate).
Perf SLOs: 95th latency increase <= 10% and P99 <= configured SLO + 50ms under expected load during canary.
Error rate: upstream API error rate increase <= 0.1 percentage points relative to control during canary.
Cost guardrail: incremental token cost per request <= 20% during ramp (absolute and weighted by route).
Observability: dashboards and traces instrumented for model, route, region, and customer tier before canary start.
evaluation_metrics: Quality metrics: eval-set score, human-rated relevance (sampled), hallucination rate on targeted prompts.
Reliability: 5xx error rate, API timeout rate, tail latencies (P95/P99), failed-generation fallback rate.
Cost: tokens per response, GPU utilization per-step, infra cost delta per 1k requests.
Business: downstream conversion/engagement delta if applicable, retention impact for user-facing features.
rollback_criteria: Immediate rollback: critical customer-facing errors (data loss, privacy leakage) or safety violation reported by trust & safety triage.
Automatic rollback: if any of the following persist for 30m: error rate increase > 0.5pp, P99 latency > SLO + 200ms, or rate-limited token cost increase > 40%.
Manual rollback: sustained quality regression on evaluation set (>1.5pp) confirmed by human review.
instrumentation_requirements: Per-variant tagging: all requests must include experiment_id and variant in telemetry payloads.
Control vs treatment dashboards: side-by-side rolling windows (1h/24h/7d) and alerting on divergence.
Sampling plan: store full traces for 100% of errors and 1% of successful responses; LM output diffs for 0.5% of requests for human review.
